flags: Feasible positive y-axis points also exist. The answer uses the question's informal quadrant wording rather than a strict exclusion of axes.
Points such as (0,5) also satisfy both inequalities. Strictly, the solution set lies in quadrants I and II together with part of the positive y-axis, rather than entirely in the two open quadrants.
